data.description:
## Context
During the 0.13.0 release (ticket hyperbolic-pernicious-drongo, Gerrit change 2385 merged as
4dafd36d2aa1), release.yml's "Publish to MCP Registry" job failed all 5 retry attempts with:

    Error: publish failed: server returned status 422: {"title":"Unprocessable Entity","status":422,
    "detail":"validation failed","errors":[{"message":"expected length <= 100",
    "location":"body.description","value":"Rebar can block work until an AI plan review passes,
    require signed completion verification before close, and reconcile its event-sourced ticket
    record with Jira across CLI, Python, and MCP."}]}

server.json's top-level "description" field (190 chars, identical to pyproject.toml's description)
exceeds the registry's <= 100 char schema constraint. PyPI publish and the GitHub Release both
succeeded (irreversible, already live for 0.13.0); only the MCP Registry publish step failed.
Nothing in local CI (make lint, scripts/check_server_manifest.py, release_guards.py) catches this
locally -- the 422 was only ever surfaced by the live registry's remote validation during the
release, after PyPI was already published.

## Plan
- Shorten server.json's top-level description to <= 100 chars (keep pyproject.toml's longer,
  descriptive form -- there is no lockstep guard requiring the two to match, confirmed by
  inspection of scripts/release_guards.py and scripts/check_server_manifest.py).
- Add a local guard (function + CLI subcommand in scripts/release_guards.py, alongside the
  existing check_version_lockstep/check_env_protection helpers) asserting server.json's top-level
  description is <= 100 chars, with a unit test in tests/unit/test_release_guards.py, so this
  fails fast locally/in CI instead of only at the live registry mid-release.
- Re-run the failed "Publish to MCP Registry" job on the existing release.yml run once this fix
  lands (the job's own retry loop first checks in_registry() and no-ops if already published, and
  mcp-publisher publish is idempotent -- no new PyPI publish is triggered).
- (Fast-follow, not in this ticket's scope) wire the new guard into release.yml's
  "Authorize release source" preflight job so a future release fails before PyPI publish rather
  than after.

## File impact
- server.json -- shorten top-level description field to satisfy the MCP registry's <= 100 char schema
- scripts/release_guards.py -- add check_mcp_registry_description guard + CLI subcommand
- tests/unit/test_release_guards.py -- unit test for the new guard

## Testing
- pytest tests/unit/test_release_guards.py -q
- make lint && make typecheck
- Manual: re-run release.yml run 33273822041's "Publish to MCP Registry" job and confirm success

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] server.json's top-level description is <= 100 characters.
- [ ] scripts/release_guards.py exposes a check for server.json description length with a passing unit test.
- [ ] The re-run "Publish to MCP Registry" job on run 33273822041 succeeds.
data.title: server.json top-level description exceeds MCP Registry's 100-char limit, blocking registry publish
